title: 第三章 太奶奶不喜欢你出去工作
content_zh:
离婚这种事不该瞒着孩子，不然以后解释起来更麻烦。

    至于这两个孩子，比起自己他们明显更亲霍廷深。可这是自己辛苦生的崽，凭什么给别人？

    她蹲下身，尽量温柔地道：“我们先搬出去住，我会照顾你们。”

    霍灵纠结地看着妈妈。

    其实她和哥哥一样，都觉得离婚后妈妈不会要他们，此刻妈妈却这样说，难道妈妈改主意了？

    她也是个聪明孩子，立刻想到要是拒绝妈妈，以后就不会有多少和妈妈见面的机会了。

    而爸爸那边，应该可以随时见面吧？

    想清楚这些，她便道：“好，我和妈妈一起住！”

    霍逸向来听妹妹的，没发表任何意见，只是问道：“我们搬去哪里？”

    宣云溪想了想，“先去酒店吧。”

    她在梳妆台里找到她的身份证了，又鼓捣半天打开手机银行，发现里面钱还挺多，住五星级也完全不心疼。

    只是，钱再多也有花完的一天，她得想个法子去做点什么。

    十分钟后，母子三人坐上出租车。

    宣云溪见司机在打电话，小声地问道：“对了，你们知道我做什么工作吗？”

    “妈妈，你是古筝老师。”霍逸也小声道，“你还有一个账号，每天在上面发自己弹古筝的视频，粉丝很多。”

    宣云溪在霍逸的提示下，点开一个b开头的粉色软件，戳进个人主页看了眼，吓了一跳，她居然有一百多万的粉丝！

    在主页里翻了翻，她发的都是不露脸的高难度古筝改编曲子，她大学时就喜欢干这个，不由得很是亲切。

    这时，微信一个叫“张总”的来了消息。

    宣云溪翻了翻和他的聊天记录，发现自己还是个独立古筝老师，平常教有钱人弹古筝，一节课中介抽成后能挣1500。

    霍逸也看到她的屏幕了，说道：“妈妈，你平时偷偷工作，你拍视频和当老师的事爸爸他们都不知道，因为太奶奶不喜欢你出去工作。”

    “……”

    她脑子被驴踢了吗？人家说不让工作她就“不”工作了，她不会反抗的吗？离谱啊！

    但幸好，她既然没舍弃音乐，未来的工作就有谱了。

    很快到了酒店。

    宣云溪把两个孩子安置好，趴在床上找律师，结果发现这年头可以用AI免费起草离婚协议了，不由得感叹科技进步真大。

    火速弄好协议，由于她对附近不太熟悉，便让酒店经理帮她把协议打印出来。

    酒店经理倒是痛快答应了，只是看她的眼神有些怪，她正好低头看手机，没发现。
content_en:
Divorce should not be hidden from children, otherwise it will be more troublesome to explain later.

    As for these two children, they are obviously closer to Huo Ting than themselves. But this is the cub that I worked so hard to give birth to, why should I give it to others?

    She knelt down and said as gently as possible: "Let's move out first, and I will take care of you."

    Huo Ling looked at her mother troubledly.

    In fact, like her brother, she felt that her mother would not want them after the divorce. But now her mother said this. Could it be that her mother had changed her mind?

    She was also a smart child and immediately thought that if she rejected her mother, she would not have many opportunities to meet her mother in the future.

    As for dad, we should be able to meet him at any time, right?

    After thinking about this clearly, she said: "Okay, I will live with my mother!"

    Huo Yi always listened to his sister and didn't express any opinions. He just asked: "Where should we move to?"

    Xuanyun Xi thought for a while, "Let's go to the hotel first."

    She found her ID card in the dressing table, and spent a long time opening the mobile banking. She found that there was quite a lot of money in it, and she didn't feel bad about staying in a five-star hotel.

    However, no matter how much money she had, she would eventually spend it all, and she had to find a way to do something.

    Ten minutes later, the mother and son got into a taxi.

    Xuan Yunxi saw the driver talking on the phone and asked in a low voice: "By the way, do you know what I do?"

    "Mom, you are a guzheng teacher." Huo Yi also whispered, "You also have an account where you post videos of yourself playing guzheng every day. You have many fans."

    At Huo Yi's prompt, Xuan Yunxi clicked on a pink software that started with "b" and went to her personal homepage to take a look. She was shocked to find that she actually had more than one million fans!

    Browsing through the homepage, she posted all difficult guzheng arrangements without showing her face. She liked to do this when she was in college, and she couldn't help but feel very friendly.

    At this time, a message came from a person named "Mr. Zhang" on WeChat.

    Xuanyunxi looked through the chat history with him and found that he was still an independent guzheng teacher. He usually taught wealthy people how to play guzheng, and he could earn 1,500 per class after the agent took a commission.

    Huo Yi also saw her screen and said, "Mom, you usually work secretly. Dad and the others don't know about you making videos and being a teacher, because my grandma doesn't like you going out to work."

    "..."

    Did she get kicked in the head? If someone says she "won't" work if she is not allowed to work, won't she resist? Ridiculous!

    But fortunately, since she has not given up music, her future work is promising.

    Arrive at the hotel soon.

    Xuan Yunxi settled her two children and lay on the bed to find a lawyer. She found out that AI can be used to draft divorce agreements for free these days. She couldn't help but sigh at how great the progress in technology has been.

    She quickly prepared the agreement, and since she was not familiar with the area, she asked the hotel manager to print it out for her.

    The hotel manager readily agreed, but he looked at her a little strangely. She happened to be looking down at her phone and didn't notice.
title_en: Chapter 3 Grandma doesn’t like you going out to work
